query:
INSERT INTO memory.knowledge_embedding_state(reference, content_hash, model_key, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 1, now() + interval '30 seconds', $4)
          ON CONFLICT(reference) DO UPDATE SET content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
          model_key = EXCLUDED.model_key, completed_at = NULL, last_error = EXCLUDED.last_error,
          attempts = CASE WHEN knowledge_embedding_state.content_hash = $2 AND knowledge_embedding_state.model_key = $3
            THEN knowledge_embedding_state.attempts + 1 ELSE 1 END,
          next_attempt_at = now() + LEAST(3600, 30 * power(2, LEAST(knowledge_embedding_state.attempts, 7))) * interval '1 second'
